body:
Required for remake v0.6.1: original-compatible SAV export and JSON-to-SAV converter, requested by owner 2026-10-17. Remake intake: https://github.com/diegoami/imperial_conquest_2/issues/1191 ; owner playtest tracker https://github.com/diegoami/imperial_conquest_2/issues/1190 . Please run this in the research repository session while remake implementation continues. This issue requests findings, not changes to remake code.

Existing research is enough to locate serialization but not to justify inheriting every omitted byte from an arbitrary SAV template. At research d5f0bc797ec23c181e854f743db1b06343e2876d, use decompiled-sav-file-layout.md (including September correction), news-log-format-and-messages.md, 2026-10-04-decompiled-tactical-battle-rules.md section1 and 2026-09-29-loading-a-save-does-not-reseed.md. Do not broadly redo the format investigation. Newer tactical evidence overrides stale 'midbattle impossible' prose.

Concrete gap: nation records are 1,172 bytes, and current public readers cover only a subset. DAT investigation identifies +0x048..+0x2E3 (668 bytes) copied into runtime with unnamed meaning. Classify this and remaining nation areas, especially stored score/bookkeeping copies +0x434 (wealth baseline), +0x43C (treasury baseline), +0x448 (city baseline), +0x44E, and preferences/control tail through +0x493. For each region, establish whether static template preservation is safe, live fields must be derived from native state, unsupported state must reject, or evidence is still missing. A full-size serialization layout or empty DeclaredUnmapped public-field set does not establish those semantics.

Also establish safe record/prototype policy for newly created armies/fleets and unused/tombstone slots, reconstructible indices/pointers/map representations, fixed-width text encoding/limits, strategic pending offers, and controller/pause flags relevant to faithful strategic export. Support each preservation/default rule with exact code/evidence; do not bless zero-fill or unrelated-template inheritance for potentially live fields.

Initial target inputs: twelve owner remake JSON saves, all classical-mediterranean/classical-faithful, 16 nations/334 cities, no open battle, 11 native format4 and latest save78 format7, turns0–7. Native saves lack original byte envelopes and have empty provenance. No byte-identical recovery or original future-RNG equivalence is claimed: original RNG is not saved. Current reader import normalizes some values and omits stale residue. Do not upload owner saves or original bytes to either code repository; coordinate private artifacts only when available.

Deliver an evidence-backed byte/field/preservation matrix and minimal safe supported-state policy. Once the exporter produces candidates, independently validate at least three representative outputs in the original Windows game: open -> inspect nation/army/fleet/town/recruitment/pending-offer state -> issue an ordinary order/end turn -> save to a NEW separate copy -> reopen. Include original-version/runtime identity and exact artifact hashes, preserve originals, and coordinate with owner so no active game is interrupted. Parsing our own output with our own reader is insufficient proof of original compatibility.

Priority: required v0.6.1 evidence dependency. File full findings in this research repository using its normal process; remake session will evaluate them before granting compatibility/export readiness. Report unresolved gaps explicitly.

comments.body:
Implementation evidence update: draft writer groundwork is preserved in https://github.com/diegoami/imperial_conquest_2/pull/1202 and full author evidence at https://github.com/diegoami/imperial_conquest_2/issues/1193#issuecomment-6239870992 . Strict strategic framing plus byte-identical identity paths passed four private templates with varying army/fleet/news counts; full build/tests green. This is not evidence that template bytes may be inherited for changed native state.

Changed-state writer/export remains blocked specifically on nation-relative +048..2E3 (668 bytes), +434..437, +43C..43F, +448..449, +44E..44F, +450..493, and validated new-record prototype/default/residue policies. Please supply the complete applicable live/canonical/safely-preserved region classification with evidence as requested in this issue, including record relocation/new records. Unknown is not static. No owner JSON or original files were modified or converted. No second research issue is needed for the same gap.

title: v0.6.1 SAV export: classify live byte regions and validate original-game round trip
